scope: All 499 main dispatch entries plus named supplementary declarations and all unique action expressions/commands in shipped system and four user panel configurations. Configurations only; no compiled plugin executed or decompiled.
mapping_limit: Static audit only. Native-core means documented core outcome exists with cited reachable code; partial means explicit automation/options missing. In-progress construction commands excluded.

sources.role: Author-written older manual on third-party mirror; explanatory cross-check only

audit_resolution.method: Read-only static tracing of command prompts, selection, mutations, model and reachable property panels; no YQArch execution and no new browser/runtime parity test.
audit_resolution.boundary: Resolved is an evidence-based classification, not proof of complete equivalence. Partial entries retain explicit gaps. Shallow official labels retain scope cautions.
